王建新看见小丫头睡得香，便把她轻轻抱起来，放到小耳房里。

他回到书桌前，坐下，拿出纸笔。窗外阳光斜斜地照进来，照在桌面上，铅笔的影子拉得长长的。他想了想，开始在纸上写字。

他准备写一份清单——他脑海中所有的中药材种子。人参、黄芪、当归、党参、枸杞、甘草、丹参、柴胡、白术、茯苓、川芎、赤芍、生地、熟地、麦冬、天冬、五味子、山楂、神曲、麦芽……一味一味地写，密密麻麻地写了好几页。

他准备去黑市问问，看看能不能买齐这些东西。从国营的地方，他没有资格购买——药材种子他打听了一下，属于统购统销，私买药材种子属于投机倒把。没有介绍信，人家也不卖。他准备看看这次开门办学，去公社卫生院有没有机会。公社卫生院接触的人多，三教九流都有，说不定能打听到黑市的路子。

不管是前生还是后世的王建新，都对黑市充满了好奇。前生记忆里知道黑市什么都能买到。粮食、布票、工业券、手表、自行车，只要有钱，没有买不到的。黑市神通广大，什么东西都能弄上。想来他要的这些种子，对他们来说应该不是难事吧。

他把清单折好，放进挎包。

下午三点，妞妞睡醒了。王建新回头一看小家伙正坐在床上揉眼睛，头发乱糟糟的，脸上还有枕头的印子。看见小叔，伸出两只手，嘴里喊着“抱抱——”

王建新抱起小家伙，来到门口不远处，蹲下来，给她把了尿。妞妞尿完了，打了个激灵，又精神了。王建新跟她玩了一会儿——举高高、转圈圈、藏猫猫，妞妞笑得咯咯的，小手拍着他的脸。

三点多点，王建新跟父母打了声招呼：“爸、妈，我去大姨家看看，然后就直接回学校了。”

母亲从屋里拿出那个狼皮褥子，卷好了，用绳子扎紧，递给王建新：“给你大姨带过去，你大姨冬天怕冷，这个正好。”

王建新接过来，夹在腋下。母亲又从屋里拿出一小布袋肉干：“这是给你大姨带的。肉干是你从草原上带回来的，再给她送点。”

王建新接过东西，心里想，他空间里还有好多肉干，但拿出来不好解释。他先用神识扫了一下父母和大嫂的身体——还行，看来吃了他的肉干对身体有所改善。父亲的气色好了些，母亲的胃病好像也轻了。等在学校再待一段时间，便帮父亲把身体上这些小毛病治好，顺便帮母亲调理调理。现在还不是时候。

王建新拿好东西，出了门。他先坐公交车，在车上找了个靠窗的位置坐下。车子晃晃悠悠地开了大半个小时，到了大姨家附近的公交站。他下了车，拐进一条胡同，找到大姨家的四合院。

大姨家住在一个大杂院里，比王建新家那个院子还挤。过道两边堆满了蜂窝煤和破木板，头顶上晾着各种衣服，王建新走到大姨家门口，敲了敲门。

门开了，大姨站在门口。五十多岁的妇女，头发花白，她看见王建新，愣了一秒，然后脸上的褶子全展开了。

“建新！快进来？”大姨一把拉住他的手，把他拽进屋，“回来了不说先来大姨家，大姨给做好吃的！”

王建新不好意思地挠挠头：“大姨，刚回来不是玩了几天吗？便到了报道时间了。”

“没事没事，来了就好。”大姨把他按在椅子上坐好，转身去倒水。大姨夫从里屋出来，戴着老花镜，手里拿着一份报纸。他看见王建新，也笑了：“建新来了？听说你当兵了，还立了一等功，真了不起啊！”

“是，大姨夫，在边防团。”王建新把狼皮褥子和肉干放在桌上，“大姨，这是我妈让我带给您的。狼皮褥子，冬天铺着暖和。肉干是草原上的，您尝尝。”

大姨接过狼皮褥子，摸了摸，毛又厚又软，眼睛亮了：“好东西！你妈老是惦记着我。”她又打开肉干的布袋，拿出一根牛肉干，咬了一口，嚼了嚼，“嗯，好吃，有嚼劲。”

When Wang Jianxin saw the little girl sleeping soundly, he gently picked her up and placed her in the small ear room.

He returned to his desk, sat down, and took out a pen and paper.The sunlight slanted in outside the window and shone on the table, making the pencil's shadow grow long.He thought for a while and started writing on the paper.

He was going to write a list of all the Chinese medicinal seeds in his mind.Ginseng, astragalus, angelica, dangshen, wolfberry, licorice, salvia, bupleurum, atractylodes, poria, chuanxiong, red peony root, raw rehmannia, cooked rehmannia, ophiopogon japonicus, asparagus, schisandra chinensis, hawthorn, divine song, malt... I wrote them one after another, and wrote densely for several pages.

He was going to ask on the black market to see if he could buy all these things.He was not qualified to buy medicinal seeds from state-owned places. He inquired about them and found that they were subject to unified purchasing and marketing. Buying medicinal seeds privately was speculative.Without a letter of introduction, they won’t sell.He was going to see if there was any chance of going to the commune health center this time when schools were opened.The commune health center comes into contact with many people from all walks of life, so they might be able to find out about the black market.

Whether in his previous life or in his later life, Wang Jianxin was full of curiosity about the black market.In my past life memory, I knew that I could buy anything on the black market.Grain, cloth tickets, industrial coupons, watches, bicycles, there is nothing that cannot be bought as long as you have money.The black market has vast powers and can get anything.I think the seeds he wants shouldn't be difficult for them.

He folded the list and put it in his satchel.

At three o'clock in the afternoon, Niu Niu woke up.Wang Jianxin turned around and saw the little guy sitting on the bed rubbing his eyes. His hair was messy and there were pillow marks on his face.Seeing my uncle, he stretched out his hands and shouted "hug——"

Wang Jianxin picked up the little guy and came not far from the door. He squatted down and peed for her.Niu Niu finished urinating, trembled, and became energetic again.Wang Jianxin played with her for a while - lifting high, spinning in circles, and hiding and cat. Niu Niu giggled and patted his face with her little hands.

At around three o'clock, Wang Jianxin said hello to his parents: "Dad, Mom, I'm going to visit my aunt's house, and then I'll go back to school directly."

Mother took out the wolf skin mattress from the house, rolled it up, tied it tightly with a rope, and handed it to Wang Jianxin: "Bring it to your aunt. Your aunt is afraid of the cold in winter, so this is just right."

Wang Jianxin took it and put it under his arm.Mother took out a small bag of dried meat from the house: "This is for your aunt. You brought some dried meat back from the grassland. Give her some more."

Wang Jianxin took the things and thought to himself that there was a lot of dried meat in his space, but it was difficult to explain when taking it out.He first scanned the bodies of his parents and sister-in-law with his consciousness - it was okay, it seemed that eating his dried meat had improved their health.My father's complexion is getting better, and my mother's stomach trouble seems to be getting better.After staying at school for a while, I will help my father cure these minor physical problems and help my mother take care of herself.Now is not the time.

Wang Jianxin took his things and went out.He took the bus first and found a seat by the window in the car.The car drove for more than half an hour and arrived at the bus stop near my aunt's house.He got out of the car, turned into an alley, and found his aunt's courtyard.

My aunt's family lives in a large courtyard, which is even more crowded than the courtyard of Wang Jianxin's house.There were piles of briquettes and broken wooden boards on both sides of the aisle, and various clothes were hanging on the head. Wang Jianxin walked to the door of his aunt's house and knocked on the door.

The door opened and my aunt was standing at the door.A woman in her fifties with gray hair was stunned for a second when she saw Wang Jianxin, and then the wrinkles on her face spread out.

"Jianxin! Come in quickly?" The aunt grabbed his hand and dragged him into the house. "When you come back, let's go to my aunt's house first. Auntie will prepare delicious food!"

Wang Jianxin scratched his head in embarrassment: "Auntie, didn't you just come back and play for a few days? It's time to report."

"It's okay, it's okay, just come." The aunt sat him down on the chair and turned around to pour water.The uncle came out of the back room, wearing reading glasses and holding a newspaper in his hand.When he saw Wang Jianxin, he also smiled: "Jianxin is here? I heard that you have become a soldier and have achieved first-class merit. How amazing!"

"Yes, uncle, he is in the border defense regiment." Wang Jianxin put the wolf skin mattress and dried meat on the table, "Auntie, this is what my mother asked me to bring you. The wolf skin mattress is warm in winter. The dried meat is from the grassland, you can try it."

The aunt took the wolf skin mattress and touched it. The fur was thick and soft, and her eyes lit up: "Good stuff! Your mother is always thinking about me." She opened the bag of dried meat, took out a stick of beef jerky, took a bite, and chewed, "Well, it's delicious and chewy."
